name: Tool selection
description: An agent needs a tool. First the kind of tool, then the exact tool. A low-confidence 'search' asks a clarifying yes/no question first.

tool_type.instructions: What type of tool is needed for this task?

criteria.search: Find text or patterns inside files
criteria.file: Read, write, move or delete files

contents_or_names.instructions: Does the task need to search inside file contents, not only file names?

criteria.true: Search inside the contents of files

search_tool.instructions: Which search tool should the agent use?

file_tool.instructions: Which file tool should the agent use?

criteria.find: Find files by name or pattern
criteria.cat: Print the contents of a file
